description: Main application code for Bluetooth dynamic transmit power control and Heart Rate Service notification in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: read_conn_rssi
methods.description: Reads the RSSI value for a given connection handle via HCI command.

methods.name: set_tx_power
methods.description: Sets the transmit power level for a specified handle and handle type via vendor-specific HCI command.

methods.name: get_tx_power
methods.description: Retrieves the current transmit power level for a specified handle and handle type via vendor-specific HCI command.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth connection establishment; manages connection handle and initial power settings.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth disconnection; releases connection reference.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth subsystem and starts advertising.

methods.name: hrs_notify
methods.description: Sends Heart Rate measurement notification with simulated data.

methods.name: modulate_tx_power
methods.description: Thread function that modulates transmit power based on connection status and RSSI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; initializes Bluetooth, starts power modulation thread, and periodically sends HR notifications.
